title: PPTAgent: Generating and Evaluating Presentations Beyond Text-to-Slides
authors: Hao Zheng, Xinyan Guan, Hao Kong, Jia Zheng, Weixiang Zhou, Hongyu Lin, Yaojie Lu, Ben He, Xianpei Han, Le Sun
abstract: Automatically generating presentations from documents is a challenging task that requires accommodating content quality, visual appeal, and structural coherence. Existing methods primarily focus on improving and evaluating the content quality in isolation, overlooking visual appeal and structural coherence, which limits their practical applicability. To address these limitations, we propose PPTAgent, which comprehensively improves presentation generation through a two-stage, edit-based approach inspired by human workflows. PPTAgent first analyzes reference presentations to extract slide-level functional types and content schemas, then drafts an outline and iteratively generates editing actions based on selected reference slides to create new slides. To comprehensively evaluate the quality of generated presentations, we further introduce PPTEval, an evaluation framework that assesses presentations across three dimensions: Content, Design, and Coherence. Results demonstrate that PPTAgent significantly outperforms existing automatic presentation generation methods across all three dimensions.
zh_title: PPTAgent：超越文本到幻灯片的演示文稿生成与评测
zh_abstract: 从文档自动生成演示文稿是一项富有挑战的任务，需要同时兼顾内容质量、视觉吸引力与结构连贯性。现有方法主要聚焦于孤立地改进与评测内容质量，忽视了视觉吸引力与结构连贯性，限制了其实用性。为弥补这些不足，我们提出 PPTAgent——一个受人类工作流程启发、通过两阶段基于编辑的方式全面提升演示文稿生成的框架。PPTAgent 首先分析参考演示文稿，抽取幻灯片级的功能类型与内容模式；随后撰写大纲，并基于选定的参考幻灯片迭代生成编辑动作，从而创建新的幻灯片。为全面评测生成演示文稿的质量，我们进一步提出 PPTEval——一个从内容、设计与连贯性三个维度评估演示文稿的评测框架。结果表明，PPTAgent 在这三个维度上均显著优于现有的自动演示文稿生成方法。
